The hamster has dense golden-brown fur, large dark eyes, and prominent rounded ears. Its front paws are visible holding the object, showing small pink digits. The background features a colorful, slightly out-of-focus pattern with red and yellow stripes, possibly part of a toy or packaging.

The ears are clearly visible, rounded in shape, and proportionally large relative to the head size, fitting the species profile.
